# Spark-TTS Africa 🌍

**Spark-TTS Africa** is an adaptation of [Spark-TTS-0.5B](https://github.com/SparkAudio/Spark-TTS) for **93 African languages and English**, fine-tuned using phonetic IPA representations generated by [africa-g2p](https://github.com/AfriSpeech/africa-g2p) on an NVIDIA H200 GPU.

Developed and maintained by the **AfriSpeech** team.

---

## Architecture Overview

Spark-TTS frames text-to-speech as a causal language modeling task:
* **Backbone:** Qwen2.5-0.5B causal language model.
* **Audio Codec:** `BiCodec` extracting dual acoustic representations:
  * Global tokens (`<|bicodec_global_{i}|>`): Speaker timbre, pitch contour, and acoustic room profile.
  * Semantic tokens (`<|bicodec_semantic_{i}|>`): Fine-grained speech phonetics and timing at 50 Hz.
* **Unified Sequence:**
  ```
  <|task_tts|><|start_content|>{african_ipa_text}<|end_content|><|start_global_token|>{global_tokens}<|end_global_token|><|start_semantic_token|>{semantic_tokens}<|end_semantic_token|><|im_end|>
  ```
* **African Phonetization:** All text inputs are normalized through `africa-g2p` to eliminate dialectal spelling ambiguities across 93 African languages.

---

## Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/AfriSpeech/spark-tts-africa.git
cd spark-tts-africa
pip install -e .

# Install African phonetic G2P and English espeak dependencies
pip install "africa-g2p @ git+https://github.com/AfriSpeech/africa-g2p" phonemizer
```

---

## Quickstart Inference

```python
from spark_tts_africa.infer import SparkTTSAfrica
import soundfile as sf

tts = SparkTTSAfrica()

# 1. Zero-shot Speech Synthesis with Automatic African IPA
audio = tts.generate(
    text="Akwaaba! Yɛfrɛ me Kofi, mepɛ sɛ mereka Twi kyerɛ wo nnɛ.",
    language="twi",
)
sf.write("twi_spark.wav", audio, tts.sampling_rate)

# 2. Voice Cloning from a Reference Audio Clip
cloned_audio = tts.generate(
    text="Sannu da zuwa! Ina fatan kuna lafiya.",
    language="hau",
    ref_audio="path/to/reference_voice.wav",
)
sf.write("hausa_cloned.wav", cloned_audio, tts.sampling_rate)
```

---

## Training Pipeline on H200

```bash
# 1. Prepare and tokenize the African speech corpus into BiCodec tokens:
python -m scripts.prepare_african_dataset \
    --input_jsonl "/mnt/volume_d2wey28/data/africa-tts/train_final.jsonl" \
    --output_parquet "/mnt/volume_d2wey28/data/spark-tts-africa/train.parquet"

# 2. Launch detached training:
bash scripts/run_train.sh
```
